name: Gemini AIA Pack
description: Modular Gemini desk cards for Automate It Away. Desk AIs draft only. Humans Yes / Stop / Kill. Collect stays HOLD.
rails: Desk AIs draft only. Never Yes, Stop, pay, or send.
Confidence below threshold routes to needs_review — never silent Yes.
Collect stays HOLD until Yes + a real money pipe.
Buyer binds their own Google AI key. AIA charges nothing.

cards.title: Triage & Route
prompt_focus: Classify priority, queue_name, next_card_id, confidence, extracted_entities.
Do not guess missing IDs, dates, or completion states.
Prefer next_card_id gemini-draft-card or gemini-deep-card or needs_review.

cards.title: Draft Reply
prompt_focus: No guaranteed timelines or unverified claims.
Nothing leaves until a human taps Yes.

cards.title: Deep Workflow Spec
prompt_focus: Propose a short multi-step desk workflow with confidence gates.
Flag needs_review when confidence is below 0.85.
Never auto-execute physical, money, or outbound send steps.
